content: Hi how can i assist you today
The store playlist said my uncommon name right when I thought of it. Felt like a direct message.
Retail playlists are preprogrammed or streamed from licensed catalogs. Was it a song lyric or a DJ tag that contained your name?
A lyric—same spelling as my name.
If you recall the chorus or a line, identifying the song can show how often that name appears in the track.
I grabbed a Shazam clip; it’s an older pop song.
Older tracks with names cycle frequently in retail mixes. If you visit a different branch at a similar hour and hear the same rotation, that points to the playlist rather than live targeting.
I’ll check the other branch this week.
Noting time and store makes the comparison straightforward.
